services.name: Knik Glacier Explorer-90 Minutes
services.desc: Fly into the breathtaking beauty of Alaska Wilderness on an exhilarating adventure! 1 hour 30 minutes About: See the Chugach Range from the air as your helicopter flight takes you over snow capped mountain peaks and braided river valleys to land on over 300 feet of glacial ice thousands of years old! Experience majestic blue pools, stunning, swirling moulins, deep crevasses and dramatic ice formations that continue to fascinate and attract the explorer in all of us when you step foot and trek around the surface of the Knik Glacier. The mighty Knik, one of the largest glaciers left Available All Year • 90min Total • 40min Flight + Glacier Landing

services.name: Iconic Alaska - Dog Mushing & Glacier
services.desc: Fly down the Knik River Valley and past the towering Pioneer Peak with views of The Sleeping Lady and Denali to Big Lake, Alaska, where you will be welcomed at The Dogstead! Home of respected Iditarod musher Nic Petit and his kennel of lovable pups. In the winter enjoy a ride atop snow packed trails under the alpenglow on a traditional dog sled. In the fall, take in the sights of changing leaves and termination dust and the feel of crisp air on your cheeks, as the dogs give you a ride of your life! Feel the rush of racing dogs and see why Nic and his pups consistently finish in the top 10 of 4 Hours • All ages

services.name: Guided Glacier Trekking (Half Day)
services.desc: This is the best half day trip that you can do in Alaska. If you are looking for an unforgettable adventure, the Half Day Helicopter Glacier excursion with Nova Guides and Outbound Heli Adventures is the perfect fit for you. Total Excursion Time: ~4 hours Flight Time: Minimum 40 Minutes (times vary slightly depending on trekking location that day) Time on glacier with NOVA guide: 3 hours 30 minutes About: This excursion is inclusive of at least 40 minutes of flight time, and three hours on the ice exploring the Knik Glacier. No trekking experience is necessary. You will be outfitted Half-Day (4hrs): Available May 15 - Sept. 15

services.name: Heli Hiking 4hrs (Half Day)
services.desc: Meet your experienced Alaskan alpinist for a guided trek tailored just for you. Choose between climatic ridge line traverses or gentle sloping tundra treks in one of sever locations. This guided adventure is a great way to experience Alaska’s large sweeping views as well as getting to see our wildlife in their natural environment. Mid summer and early fall are also great times to pick our native berries while on a hike (blueberries, crow berries, and low bush cranberries)! Cool down after your hike by adding a landing on the Knik Glacier! Flight Time: 45 minutes Total Excursion Half-Day (4hrs): Available Jun 1 - Sept 15 • All Ages
